prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: a buy-to-let flat. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"A buy-to-let flat may be insured under a landlord arrangement provided it is occupied under a formal tenancy agreement. However, the policyholder must act promptly to stop the leak and prevent further loss."},{"type":"fact","content":"The policy does not insure loss of rent unless that cover has been specifically selected and shown on the schedule.
